target.purpose: Represent lane-topology uncertainty explicitly so route selection cannot silently collapse UNKNOWN into FREE or let conflicting edge declarations create order-dependent truth.
target.central_bottleneck: Route semantics become misleading when topology state is mutable by insertion order or when uncertainty is discarded during path selection.
success: Edges preserve FREE, UNKNOWN, and BLOCKED as distinct states.
Conflicting redefinitions of a directed edge fail closed.
Default path search refuses UNKNOWN edges.
Equal-hop route choice is deterministic across insertion order.
Explicit uncertainty-first routing minimizes UNKNOWN-edge count before hop count.
Route decisions bind exact graph identity and route policy.
Python and Go preserve the same core route outcomes.

invariants: edge state is one of FREE, UNKNOWN, BLOCKED
UNKNOWN is never treated as FREE by default
conflicting directed edge state fails closed
unknown endpoints cannot yield phantom paths
route choice is deterministic for a fixed topology and policy

donor_plan.basis: This repository owns uncertainty-aware topology/routing; the freespace certificate owns bounded-grid certification and remains separate.

nonclaims: reference engineering system, not a production autonomous-driving deployment
no freespace certification or sensor-provenance authentication
no trajectory or autonomous-driving actuation authority
no sibling integration without executable composition proof
